- What is this change?
- How has it been tested?
- Does it affect any existing functionality?

This pull request introduces [JIRA-123](https://officefornationalstatistics.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-123)

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds new functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature which would change expected behaviour or break backwards compatibility)
- [ ] Non-functional change (structure, dev functionality, documentation, etc.)

## Checklist
- [ ] Amend the changelog to include a description of the feature/fix
- [ ] Comment code where needed, focusing on why not how
- [ ] Implement or amend unit tests to prove the feature/fix works as intended
- [ ] Check new and existing unit tests pass locally
- [ ] Check the pipeline runs
- [ ] Update all relevant documentation
